findings.passage: Let’s be honest and call this what it is: unconstitutional.
findings.note: In a guest column she wrote for a newspaper (signed as state party chair at the time), she described a draft House bill, "Prohibition of Assault Weapons in Colorado", that would bar possessing, making, buying or selling a listed set of guns including semi-automatic pistols, and called it unconstitutional.

findings.passage: We must stand up and fight against this unconstitutional legislation.
findings.note: Same column: she urges opposing the draft assault-weapons ban and says the legislature should focus on crime rather than on gun owners.
